about: The player's first-person view: camera, FS2-style motion dust, placeholder starfield. Look is placeholder; these numbers serve the feel of speed.

camera.why: 55 degrees vertical is about 86 horizontal at 16:9: wide enough that things streaming past the edges sell speed, not so wide that targets ahead shrink. Eye a little up and forward of the ship's centre; the ship itself is never drawn (seated: the HUD takes over).

dust.why: FS2's motion debris: specks fixed in space around the player, drawn as short streaks along the player's velocity, so speed reads even with nothing else near. 0.04 s of travel per streak: 2.8 m at cruise (70 m/s), 6 m on afterburner. Specks fade in at the far radius and out right next to the eye so none pop.

stars.why: Off: the Sky system now draws the real star catalogue. A count above 0 brings back the placeholder points (scenes without the sky).
